title: Listen and Choose a Response — After Class

questions.stem: You can use my umbrella if you're walking to the bus.

options.A: The bus is usually on time.
options.C: Thanks, I'll give it back to you tomorrow.
options.D: Yes, I'm using my own umbrella.

questions.explanation: Accepting the offer and promising to return it is appropriate; the 'Yes' option contradicts accepting.
